mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (bot_id, user_id, role, content, rich_content, metadata) VALUES (#{botId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{richContent}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT id, bot_id, user_id, role, content, rich_content, metadata, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_message WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND user_id = #{userId}
